title: platanus × hispanica var. pyramidata
intro: Platanus × hispanica var. pyramidata, commonly known as the London Planetree, is a deciduous tree that is a hybrid of the Oriental plane (Platanus orientalis) and the American sycamore (Platanus occidentalis). The London Planetree has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. Its therapeutic actions include bronchodilation, mucolytic effects, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the London Planetree include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
